method: Nearest timestamp, then same session/item/index and stable real decoder state; project with measured rate to later remote timestamp; circular media-position difference.
limits: No acoustic capture: positions do not prove identical sound arrival from speakers.
Clock bounds are supplied estimates plus conservative full sample delay, not experimentally proven absolute accuracy.
Projection assumes reported rate stays constant within maxPairGapMs; seeks/buffering/holdover are rejected and counted.
No automatic PASS threshold; convergence/transition and real acoustic acceptance remain separate.
